text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And just like that, another year's over.
Man, time really flies~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...The Sprinters Stakes is next month, right?

Hishi Akebono said she wanted to decide our future direction
after the Sprinters Stakes.

Should I lose weight,
or stick to my current style—
choice_data_list: (Either way, it's going to be a painful choice.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Well, you never really know what the future holds, do ya?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Let's keep our spirits high, Trainer!

And so, the passionate summer training camp
with Hishi Akebono came to an end.
